001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.serialize;
002
003import org.bukkit.Location;
004import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
005
006public final class BlockPos {
007
008  private final int version = 2;
009  private final int x;
010  private final int y;
011  private final int z;
012  private final String world;
013
014  public BlockPos(@NotNull final Location location) {
015
016    this.x = location.getBlockX();
017    this.y = location.getBlockY();
018    this.z = location.getBlockZ();
019    this.world = location.getWorld().getName();
020  }
021
022  public BlockPos(final int x, final int y, final int z, final String world) {
023
024    this.x = x;
025    this.y = y;
026    this.z = z;
027    this.world = world;
028  }
029
030  public static BlockPos deserialize(final String string) {
031
032    try {
033      final String[] split = string.split(";");
034      if(split.length < 5) {
035        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid input string for deserialization");
036      }
037      return new BlockPos(Integer.parseInt(split[1]), Integer.parseInt(split[2]), Integer.parseInt(split[3]), split[4]);
038    } catch(NumberFormatException e) {
039      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Failed to parse integer during deserialization", e);
040    }
041  }
042
043  public int getX() {
044
045    return x;
046  }
047
048  public int getY() {
049
050    return y;
051  }
052
053  public int getZ() {
054
055    return z;
056  }
057
058  public String getWorld() {
059
060    return world;
061  }
062
063  @Override
064  public String toString() {
065
066    return "BlockPos{" + "version=" + version + ", x=" + x + ", y=" + y + ", z=" + z + ", world='" + world + '\'' + '}';
067  }
068
069  public String serialize() {
070
071    return version + ";" + x + ";" + y + ";" + z + ";" + world;
072  }
073
074  @Override
075  public boolean equals(final Object o) {
076
077    if(o == this) return true;
078    if(!(o instanceof BlockPos)) return false;
079    final BlockPos other = (BlockPos)o;
080    if(this.version != other.version) return false;
081    if(this.getX() != other.getX()) return false;
082    if(this.getY() != other.getY()) return false;
083    if(this.getZ() != other.getZ()) return false;
084    final Object thisWorld = this.getWorld();
085    final Object otherWorld = other.getWorld();
086    if(thisWorld == null? otherWorld != null : !thisWorld.equals(otherWorld)) return false;
087    return true;
088  }
089
090  @Override
091  public int hashCode() {
092
093    final int PRIME = 59;
094    int result = 1;
095    result = result * PRIME + this.version;
096    result = result * PRIME + this.getX();
097    result = result * PRIME + this.getY();
098    result = result * PRIME + this.getZ();
099    final Object worldValue = this.getWorld();
100    result = result * PRIME + (worldValue == null? 43 : worldValue.hashCode());
101    return result;
102  }
103}
